notes: Only scan013 was inspected. Before any image, the entire brief_v10.md and all six supplied scan013 packet texts were read, including the complete notation snapshot. No other reader's output, other scan, external source, OCR, recognition tool, or PDF text layer was used. The first recorded start timestamp follows packet reading and immediately precedes image inspection.

The whole source was opened once for layout, followed by half_a and half_b once each in that order. Every text block and every inline/display formula, including agreed material, was compared line by line against BOTH C and H. Twelve still-open loci were listed before the twelve crops were made. Each crop was inspected once. No whole image, half, or crop was reopened, and no locus was recropped. Half-settled differences carry approximate whole-source boxes recorded without revisiting an image.

This is a wholly handwritten text leaf with a lower explanatory brace and one cancelled mathematical index. The packet does not establish the pen writer's identity, so the inventory uses an unnamed hand. A separate pencil 12 at lower-left is the archive sheet number. No author page number, title, date, address, salutation, signature, or stated total page count is visible. No independent diagram, drawing, marginal pointer, insertion caret or inserted correction was found.

The opening asks whether relative cohomology can be defined functorially in an abelian sheaf or complex on Y. It says the geometric interpretation in terms of n-champs de Picard, with n described as grand, suggests that such a construction should exist. The tentative language is preserved. The text mentions two extreme cases, but only a) appears on this leaf.

Case a) states a (-1)-acyclicity condition by injectivity and gives a slice-to-topos example under an epimorphism condition. The doubtful connective is retained as si/où rather than inferred from mathematics. The source calls the B-object reference plus haut; no other page was used to identify that reference.

The final formula retains its cancelled Gamma index, square opening delimiter, four round closes after F before the shift, and exact observed underbrace endpoint. The lower label reads résol. inj. H's editorial note credits those words; the report does not call the label wholly absent. The spanning brace and its attachment nevertheless differ from H's presentation.

No visible full stop follows exister at the right paper edge, and none follows the NB closing parenthesis. No punctuation was supplied from grammar or from a possible lost off-edge continuation. Lower returns in injectif belong to the j/f forms rather than to an independent underline.

The recurring morphism-letter ambiguity is graphic. Several left-returning descenders favour g, but a one-storey q cannot be ruled out. The doubt is marked at the first occurrence only, and later occurrences use g under that notation entry. The first B subscript is reordered to c/e because its outline is open without a secure crossbar; the terminal-object interpretation was not used to force e.

The rule beneath fonctoriellement does not cover the entire word. Its starting point overlaps only the trailing part of n. The two retained spans differ over including that n; initial fo and final ent are definitely outside the rule. Physical endpoints are recorded rather than replacing them with full-word semantic emphasis.

H's opening archival-order paragraph is explicitly editorial metadata, not ink on this leaf. It was not copied into the diplomatic reading or treated as a fabricated source passage. No historical or cross-page conclusion was adopted from it. H's page{12} already records the same archive number, so no number-omission difference was manufactured.

C and H use different ordinary-Latin font wrappers for Ab. Both encode the same A and b identity, without underlining or a distinct special alphabet in the source; this wrapper difference was not counted separately. The two R forms, by contrast, visibly contain an additional internal upright and are recorded as substantive alphabet differences from H's plain R.

No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, computation, formal certificate, or theoretical correctness check was performed. Delimiter counts, indices, arrow shapes and brace extents were visual transcription checks only. Statements encountered on the page are reported as source statements, not as checks; math_checks is therefore empty.
